NoticeId.description:
Identifier of a notice.

Starts with `ntc_`.

NoticeKind.description: What a notice tells the agent about.

oneOf.description: An exported signature changed in code the target seat's claims reference.
A claim the target seat was waiting for was released.
A deferred edit of the target seat was applied.
A lore entry in scope of the target seat may be out of date.

SeatId.description:
Identifier of a seat: one agent session (or human editing session) working in a repository.

Starts with `seat_`.

description: A one-way system message from ACS to a seat, delivered in the seat's next hook context.

body.description: The text shown to the agent. Written for the agent: what changed and what to do about it.

delivered_at.description: When it was delivered (UTC). Absent until delivered.

target_seat.description: The seat the notice is for.

title: Notice
